case.summary: This is an online card-not-present transaction on a device marked new for the account, with no proxy recorded and an identity match check that failed. The card has never been used on this device before, and every one of the card's unnamed match flags is true, which pushes the evidence toward fraud. At the same time, the amount is not a sub-$5 probe, the billing country is the cardholder's home country, and the card has prior history and prior purchases of product code R, so this is not a card-testing or out-of-region pattern. The evidence most strongly fits card-not-present fraud from a new device rather than a confirmed legitimate purchase.
